welcome_text: New this year: we're delighted to welcome Bellhaven Meadows of Findlay to the Bellhaven family, expanding our services in Findlay, OH.
about_text: About Bellhaven Founded in 2003, Bellhaven Senior Living operates communities across Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, and Pennsylvania. In 2025 we welcomed the Harborview Care Group family of communities, and in 2026 we expanded further with select communities joining us from Cedar Trail. We believe every resident deserves dignity, connection, and outstanding care.
